name: Echo Knight
description: A mysterious and feared frontline warrior of the Kryn Dynasty, the Echo Knight has mastered the art of using dunamis to summon the fading shades of unrealized timelines to aid them in battle.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.description:
You can use a bonus action to magically manifest an echo of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you. This echo is a magical, translucent, gray image of you that lasts until it is destroyed, until you dismiss it as a bonus action, until you manifest another echo, or until you're incapacitated.
Your echo has AC 14 + your proficiency bonus, 1 hit point, and immunity to all conditions. If it has to make a saving throw, it uses your saving throw bonus for the roll. It is the same size as you, and it occupies its space.
On your turn, you can mentally command the echo to move up to 30 feet in any direction (no action required).
If your echo is ever more than 30 feet from you at the end of your turn, it is destroyed.
You can use the echo in the following ways:
As a bonus action, you can teleport, magically swapping places with your echo at a cost of 15 feet of your movement, regardless of the distance between the two of you.
• When you take the Attack action on your turn, any attack you make with that action can originate from your space or the echo's space. You make this choice for each attack.
When a creature that you can see within 5 feet of your echo moves at least 5 feet away from it, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against that creature as if you were in the echo's space.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.description:
You can heighten your echo's fury. Whenever you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from the echo's position.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.description: You can temporarily transfer your consciousness to your echo. As an action, you can see through your echo's eyes and hear through its ears. During this time, you are deafened and blinded. You can sustain this effect for up to 10 minutes, and you can end it at any time (requires no action). While your echo is being used in this way, it can be up to 1,000 feet away from you without being destroyed.

features.name: Shadow Martyr
features.description:
You can make your echo throw itself in front of an attack directed at another creature that you can see. Before the attack roll is made, you can use your reaction to teleport the echo to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the targeted creature. The attack roll that triggered the reaction is instead made against your echo.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.description:
You've learned to absorb the fleeting magic of your echo. When an echo of yours is destroyed by taking damage, you can gain a number of temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier, provided you don't already have temporary hit points.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Legion of One
features.description:
You can use a bonus action to create two echoes with your Manifest Echo feature, and these echoes can coexist. If you try to create a third echo, the previous two echoes are destroyed. Anything you can do from one echo's position can be done from the other's instead.
In addition, when you roll initiative and have no uses of your Unleash Incarnation feature left, you regain one use of that feature.

name: Chronurgy Magic
description: Chronurgy Magic is a wizard subclass that focuses on the manipulation of time and temporal magic, allowing the wizard to alter the flow of time and control the order of events.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.description: At 2nd level, you can magically exert limited control over the flow of time around a creature. As a reaction, after you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can force the creature to reroll. You make this decision after you see the roll, whether it succeeds or fails. The target must use the result of the second roll. You can use this ability twice, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.description: At 2nd level, you can add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.description: At 6th level, you can magically force a creature you can see within 60 feet of you to become frozen in a moment of time. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated and have a speed of 0 for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the effect ends on the target. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.description: At 10th level, you can store a spell in a special bead of temporal energy. When you cast a spell using a spell slot of 4th level or lower, you can choose to store the spell in the bead instead of having it take effect immediately. The bead is a Tiny object that can be held or carried. A creature holding the bead can use its action to release the stored spell, which has the same effect as if you had cast it, using your spellcasting ability modifier and spell save DC. The spell remains in the bead for 1 hour, after which it dissipates. You can have only one bead at a time, and creating a new bead causes the previous one to lose its magic. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Convergent Future
features.description: At 14th level, you can peer into possible futures and magically pull one of them into the present. When you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to choose to have the roll succeed or fail. You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

name: Graviturgy Magic
description: Students of the Graviturgy arcane tradition learn to bend and manipulate the violent energy of gravity to their benefit.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.description: As an action, you can magically alter the weight of one object or creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The object or creature must be Large or smaller. The target's weight is halved or doubled for up to 1 minute or until your concentration ends (as if you were concentrating on a spell). While the weight of a creature is halved by this effect, the creature's speed increases by 10 feet, it can jump twice as far as normal, and it has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. While the weight of a creature is doubled by this effect, the creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Upon reaching 10th level in this class, you can target an object or a creature that is Huge or smaller.

features.name: Gravity Well
features.description: You've learned how to manipulate gravity around a living being: whenever you cast a spell on a creature, you can move the target 5 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice if the target is willing to move, the spell hits it with an attack, or it fails a saving throw against the spell.

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.description: When another creature that you can see within 60 feet of you hits with a weapon attack, you can use your reaction to increase the attack's velocity, causing the attack's target to take an extra 1d10 damage of the weapon's type. Alternatively, if a creature within 60 feet of you takes damage from a fall, you can use your reaction to increase the fall's damage by 2d10. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Event Horizon
features.description: As an action, you can magically emit a powerful field of gravitational energy that tugs at other creatures for up to 1 minute or until your concentration ends (as if you were concentrating on a spell). For the duration, whenever a creature hostile to you starts its turn within 30 feet of you, it must make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it takes 2d10 force damage, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, and every foot it moves this turn costs 2 extra feet of movement. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest or until you expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher on it.

name: Path of the Juggernaut
description: Barbarians who follow the Path of the Juggernaut become unstoppable forces of destruction, anchoring themselves against any force that would move them and hurling foes through the air.

features.name: Spirit of the Mountain
features.description: While you are raging, you can't be knocked prone or moved along the ground against your will.

features.name: Demolishing Might
features.description: Your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d8 damage to constructs, and deal double damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Resolute Stance
features.description: At the start of your turn, you can assume a defensive stance until the start of your next turn. While in this stance, you can't be grappled, attack rolls against you have disadvantage, and your weapon attacks are made with disadvantage.

features.name: Thunderous Blows
features.description: Starting at 10th level, you can push a creature up to 10 feet when you hit it with a melee attack while you're raging.

features.name: Hurricane Strike
features.description: As a reaction when you push a creature at least 5 feet, you can leap into an unoccupied space next to the creature. The creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: College of Tragedy
description: Bards of the College of Tragedy know that sorrow and pathos are emotions just as potent as joy and delight. They specialize in the power of tragic storytelling, weaving words and spells together to dramatic and devastating effect.

features.name: Poetry in Misery
features.description: Whenever you or an ally within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use your reaction to regain one expended use of your Bardic Inspiration feature.

features.name: Sorrowful Fate
features.description: When you or an ally forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to change the save type to a Wisdom save instead. If the target fails, roll a Bardic Inspiration die; the target takes psychic damage equal to the result and is plagued with regret for 1 minute.

features.name: Nimbus of Pathos
features.description: You can touch a willing creature as an action and empower it with tragic heroism for 1 minute. The creature gains +4 AC, advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, and deals extra 1d10 radiant damage on hits. Any weapon attack against the creature scores a crit on 18-20. When the effect ends, the creature drops to 0 hit points and is dying. Once per long rest.

name: Blood Domain
description: The Blood Domain centers around the understanding of the natural life force as it exists within the body, and the divine conduit it can become. Those who take up this domain understand that the power of blood is the power of sacrifice.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons.

features.name: Bloodletting Focus
features.description: When you cast a damage-dealing spell of 1st level or higher with instantaneous duration, any creature with blood that takes damage takes extra necrotic damage equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Crimson Bond
features.description: Form a supernatural bond with a creature you can see. Lasts 1 hour or until concentration breaks. You can learn the target's distance, direction, current hp, and conditions. You can also attempt to see/hear through the target's senses for a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Blood Puppet
features.description: Briefly control a Large or smaller creature or corpse with blood within 60 feet. Target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or you control its movement and actions for a short duration.

name: Moon Domain
description: Clerics of the Moon Domain draw on their divine connection to the moons to wield light and shadow, invoke good fortune and ill favor, and reveal or conceal as they see fit.

features.name: Clarity of Catha
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw, you can use your reaction to grant advantage on the save. Usable proficiency bonus times per long rest.

features.name: Mind of Two Moons
features.description: You can maintain concentration on two Moon Domain spells at once. When you take damage, you make a Constitution save with disadvantage or lose concentration on both.

features.name: Empowered Cantrips
features.description: Your cleric cantrips deal extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

features.name: Eclipse of Ill Omen
features.description: As a bonus action, create dim light in a 60-foot radius. Creatures in the area make saving throws with disadvantage. Once per turn when you deal radiant damage in the area, you can curse a creature: its speed is halved and it can't regain hp. Lasts up to 1 minute (concentration). Once per long rest.

name: Circle of the Blighted
description: Druids of the Circle of the Blighted channel corrupted natural energy, binding themselves to poisoned or tainted natural sites and wielding the power of rot and decay.

features.name: Defile Ground
features.description: As a bonus action, corrupt a 10-foot radius patch of land or water within 60 feet for 1 minute. The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures. Creatures in the area take an extra 1d4 necrotic damage when hit for the first time on a turn. Can move the corruption 30 feet as a bonus action. Once per short or long rest. Radius increases to 20 feet at 10th level, extra damage to 1d6 at 10th and 1d8 at 14th.

features.name: Blighted Shape
features.description: You gain proficiency in Intimidation. While in Wild Shape, your beast form gains +2 AC and darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet if already has darkvision).

features.name: Call of the Shadowseeds
features.description: When a creature that is not undead or construct takes damage within your Defile Ground, you can use your reaction to summon a blighted sapling that attacks a creature within 5 feet.

features.name: Incarnation of Corruption
features.description: You gain resistance to necrotic damage and +2 AC. When you start your turn within your Defile Ground, you can gain temp hp equal to your proficiency bonus as a bonus action.

name: Way of the Cobalt Soul
description: Monks of the Cobalt Soul dedicate themselves to the pursuit of knowledge, studying their enemies to break through mental and physical defenses.

features.name: Extract Aspects
features.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and learn its damage vulnerabilities, resistances, immunities, and condition immunities.

features.name: Extort Truth
features.description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 ki point to force a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't deliberately lie for up to 10 minutes.

features.name: Mystical Erudition
features.description: You learn one language and gain proficiency in one skill (Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion). Gain additional at 11th and 17th level.

features.name: Mind of Mercury
features.description: Once per turn, if you've already taken your reaction, you may spend 1 ki point to take an additional reaction.

name: Oath of the Open Sea
description: Paladins who swear the Oath of the Open Sea champion freedom, trusting the guidance of nature and adapting like water to overcome any obstacle.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Marine Layer
features.description: As an action, create a 20-foot radius cloud of fog that moves with you. The area is heavily obscured, but you and creatures within 5 feet treat it as lightly obscured. Lasts 10 minutes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Fury of the Storm
features.description: As a bonus action, channel the power of storms to grant yourself advantage on attack rolls until the end of your turn.

features.name: Aura of Liberation
features.description: You and allies within 10 feet cannot be grappled or restrained, and ignore underwater movement/attack penalties. Becomes 30 feet at 18th level.

features.name: Stormy Waters
features.description: As a reaction when a creature moves into or out of your reach, it takes 1d12 bludgeoning damage and must make a Strength save or be knocked prone.

features.name: Mythic Swashbuckler
features.description: As an action, gain benefits for 1 minute: advantage on Athletics, climbing speed equal to walking speed, advantage on attacks when within 5 feet of a creature with no other creatures within 5 feet, can Dash/Disengage as a bonus action, advantage on Dexterity checks and saves. Once per long rest.

name: Runechild
description: Runechild sorcerers manifest their innate magic as runes that appear on their skin, storing magical energy and unleashing it in powerful ways.

features.name: Essence Runes
features.description: You start with 1 essence rune, gaining another each level. When you expend sorcery points, an equal number of essence runes become charged. Charged runes power your Runechild features.

features.name: Glyph of Aegis
features.description: As a bonus action, you or a creature within 30 feet gains protective runes. The next time that creature takes damage within the next hour, it rolls 1d6 per charged rune spent and reduces the damage by the total. Die becomes d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Sigilic Augmentation
features.description: Expend a charged rune as a reaction to gain advantage on Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution ability checks or saving throws.

features.name: Manifest Inscriptions
features.description: As an action, expend a charged rune to reveal hidden arcane traps, marks, runes, wards, sensors, or glyphs within 60 feet for 1 minute.

features.name: Runic Torrent
features.description: When you cast a spell, expend 2 charged runes to change its damage to force damage. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone or pushed 15 feet.

name: Blood Magic
description: Blood Magic wizards use the magical art of hemocraft, weaving their life force into spells and using blood to fuel their arcane power.

features.name: Blood Channeling
features.description: You can use your own life force to power your magic. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher and have no available spell slots, you can sacrifice hit points equal to 5 times the spell's level to cast it.

features.name: Sanguine Burst
features.description: Whenever you roll damage for a spell you've cast of 1st level or higher, you can take necrotic damage equal to the spell's level to reroll a number of damage dice up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one).

features.name: Bond of Mutual Suffering
features.description: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to take damage equal to the damage you took. Cannot be used against constructs or undead. Once per short or long rest (twice at 14th).

features.name: Glyph of Hemorrhaging
features.description: When you damage a creature with a spell, you can curse it for 1 minute. Whenever the cursed creature is hit by an attack, it takes an extra 1d6 necrotic damage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Thicker Than Water
features.description: Whenever a spell or magical effect causes you to regain hit points, you regain additional hp equal to your proficiency bonus. While concentrating, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
